service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE ,TYPE ,CODE ,TEXT1 ,TEXT2 FROM (SELECT HOUSE_CODE , TYPE , CODE , TEXT1 , TEXT2 , RANK() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN LANGUAGE = ${session.LANGUAGE} THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, LANGUAGE) RANK FROM SCODE WHERE TYPE = 'M000' AND ( UPPER( CODE ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT1 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT2 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') OR UPPER( TEXT3 ) LIKE CONCAT('%' , UPPER( $S{F_KEYWORD} ) , '%') ) AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( CLIENT_CUSTOM_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'Y' ) AS CODE WHERE RANK = 1 ORDER BY CODE
